title: Staff
wikitext:
'''Staves''' are an [[item class]] of two-handed [[melee]] [[weapons]] that require [[strength]] and [[intelligence]], as well as a moderately high base [[critical strike chance]].

Staves are split into two categories: regular Staves and [[Warstaves]]. Warstaves cannot roll caster-based affixes, and regular Staves can roll all kinds of staff affixes. 

Generic staves have a {{c|mod|x% Chance to Block Spell Damage while wielding a Staff}} [[implicit]] [[modifier]], while warstaves have {{c|mod|x% Chance to Block Attack Damage while wielding a Staff}} [[implicit]] [[modifier]]. 

[[Maraketh weapon]]s with this item class have a {{c|mod|x% increased Global Critical Strike Chance}} [[implicit]] instead. Generic staves from [[Experimented base type]]s grant {{c|mod|+# to maximum Energy Shield, Spend Energy Shield before Mana for Costs of Socketed Skills}}, and warstaves grant {{c|mod|+1 to Maximum Power Charges and Maximum Endurance Charges}}.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* Implicit Block Modifiers on Staves no longer explicitly state they require a Staff.
* Chance to Block Attack Damage and Chance to Block Spell Damage Modifiers can now roll on Staves. Corresponding Crafting Bench Modifiers have also been added.
* Modifiers to the level of all Spell Skill Gems and all Spell Skill Gems of a specific damage type on Staves now all have an additional Modifier tier. The lower tier Modifiers appear much more commonly and can roll on Staves at earlier levels. Modifiers to the level of all Spell Skill Gems of a specific damage type go up to +4 at the maximum Modifier tier (previously +3).
* Increased Spell Damage, Fire Damage, Cold Damage and Lightning Damage Prefix Modifiers on Staves have been increased at all Modifier tiers, up to 200% increased at the Maximum tiers (previously 164%). Relevant Crafting Bench, Essence, Veiled, Influenced and Incursion Temple modifiers have been also increased accordingly. This extends to increased Trap Damage, Mine Damage, Burning Damage, Poison Damage and Bleeding Damage Prefix Modifiers on Staves.
* All of the highest tier increased Spell Damage, Fire Damage, Cold Damage and Lightning Damage Prefix Modifiers on caster weapons are now more common, except for the very highest tier.
* Hybrid increased Spell/Minion Damage and Mana Prefix Modifiers on caster weapons have been increased at all Modifier tiers, up to 49% increased at the maximum tier on one-hand weapons (previously 39%), and up to 86% on Staves (previously 49%).
* Added Damage to Spells Prefix Modifiers on caster weapons have been buffed, with larger buffs at higher modifier tiers and on staves. The highest tier Modifier on one-hand caster weapons now adds up to 84 to 146 Fire Damage to Spells (previously 66-115). The highest tier Modifier on Staves now adds up to 140 to 246 Fire Damage to Spells (from 88-155). Similar buffs have occurred for added Cold, Lightning, Physical and Chaos modifiers. Relevant Crafting Bench, Essence, Veiled, Influenced and Incursion Temple modifiers have been also increased accordingly.
* Caster weapons no longer roll increased Fire, Cold and Lightning Damage Suffix Modifiers, nor can these Modifiers be crafted at the crafting bench anymore.
* Increased Spell Critical Strike Chance Modifiers on one-handed caster weapons now roll values from 40-109% (previously 10-109%). Added a new set of increased Spell Critical Strike Chance modifiers on Staves which have 50% higher values than the corresponding modifiers on one-handed caster weapons. Relevant Essence and Crafting Bench modifiers have been increased accordingly.
* Reduced Enemy Stun Threshold Modifiers no longer roll on Sceptres or caster Staves.
* The top tier increased Cast Speed Modifiers on caster weapons now have the same weightings as the lower tier modifiers (previously these had lower weightings).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.26.0|
* Sceptres, Staves, Rune Daggers and Wands now roll Attack Modifiers less often (Warstaves and Attack Daggers are unaffected by this change).
* Staves now roll a higher tier of increased Mana Regeneration Rate, scaling up to 105% at the highest tier.
* The chance to Ignite, chance to Freeze, and chance to Shock Modifiers on Staves, Sceptres, and Wands have had the values they provide increased. They now have up to 55% chance on Staves, and 40% chance on Sceptres and Wands.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.8.0|
* Several Staves are now classified as Warstaves. Warstaves can no longer roll caster-related modifiers, while Staves retain their old mod generation behaviour.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* The following staves can no longer roll spell-based mods such as added damage for spells or increased spell damage. Their base attack speeds have been slightly increased, and their damage decreased to compensate. These changes affect all existing versions of these basetypes, though they will not affect the mods those items currently have. Also some level requirements have changed I guess? Anyway, here you go: {{il|Iron Staff}}, {{il|Coiled Staff}}, {{il|Vile Staff}}, {{il|Military Staff}}, {{il|Serpentine Staff}}, {{il|Foul Staff}}, {{il|Ezomyte Staff}}, {{il|Maelström Staff}} and {{il|Judgement Staff}}.
* The above staves will be swapped to a new "'''War Staff'''" weapon class in the [[Version 3.8.0#Item Balance|near future]] to help differentiate them.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
